implementation_notes: Verified node --check on execution-report.js (syntax OK) after every edit. Ran the modified script against three synthetic well-formed evidence trees built in scratch (not read from parity/, which stayed untouched and unread beyond the plan's own references): (1) a minimal completed job with no phase evidence -> ran end to end, produced execution_report.json/.md, decision QUARANTINE (missing-phase-evidence gate, expected for the synthetic tree), schema_version 1.5.0, failure_reason_severity null (no failure_reason recorded) confirming the additive field renders correctly on the PROMOTE/no-failure path too; (2) failed status + failure_reason EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH -> exit code 2, decision QUARANTINE, decision_reason 'Job failed with quarantine-class reason (EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH); non-retriable.' (byte-identical to the pre-existing QUARANTINE_REASONS branch string, just with the new reason substituted), failure_reason_severity 'non-retriable'; (3) failed status + failure_reason BUILD_GATE_FAILURE (an existing, untouched reason) -> exit code 1, decision RETRY, failure_reason_severity 'retriable', decision_reason unchanged in wording from before this change. Also require()'d the module directly and confirmed severityForReason is exported and returns the expected value for ADVOCATE_DISSENT (non-retriable), EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH (non-retriable), BUILD_GATE_FAILURE (retriable), and null/undefined (null); confirmed NO_RETRY_REASONS.has('EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH') and QUARANTINE_REASONS.has('EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_BREACH') are both true. Confirmed no existing reason string's decideLifecycle branch or decision_reason text changed by reading the diff line by line and by exercising BUILD_GATE_FAILURE above. Confirmed via git diff --name-only that exactly the four planned files changed and neither adws-pipeline/skill-manifest.json nor anything under parity/ or spike/ was touched (git diff --name-only against those paths returned empty). Confirmed the phase-gates.md H2 heading is byte-identical pre/post by diffing `git show HEAD:...` against the working file at that line. One deviation from the plan's literal file_change_proposal wording: rather than listing PR_DRIFT_SENTINEL_BLOCK's Verdict class simply as QUARANTINE (which the plan's summary paraphrase implied), the table marks it retriable/RETRY because that is what severityForReason() actually computes for a reason string not present in either code set (confirmed by grep: PR_DRIFT_SENTINEL_BLOCK appears in execution-report.js only inside gate detail/reason prose, never in NO_RETRY_REASONS or QUARANTINE_REASONS) -- marking it non-retriable in the table would violate the plan's own criterion-4 sourcing rule (severity must be sourced from the code's classification, not from this document's separate prose) and would fail the criteria_map's own stated check ("the set of reasons the table marks non-retriable equals the union of NO_RETRY_REASONS and QUARANTINE_REASONS"). The row's note preserves the documented second-BLOCK quarantine behaviour by explaining it operates through final_status:"quarantined" (decideLifecycle's unconditional quarantined-status branch), not through failure_reason-set membership -- this keeps the reason's existing meaning intact (constraint: never redefine) while keeping the new severity column strictly code-sourced (constraint: never re-derive from gate detail prose). Did not read anything under spike/, docs/, or parity/ per the operator constraint; did not modify adws-pipeline/skill-manifest.json (expected drift, operator-resolved per the plan).
